title: Session expires between prepare and commit
description: The trusted call session reaches its expiry (clock advanced past expiresAt) after the action is prepared and before commit. TTL cleanup has NOT run, so the session row still exists.
callerVisible: Caller hears that verification has to be repeated before the change can be made and is offered re-verification or a person; no claim that the change happened.
backendEvidence: Commit rejected with a session-expired reason code
Pending action invalidated or left unconfirmed
Audit event for the denied commit

registry.injectionPoint: session expiry between prepare and commit (injected clock)

postconditions: The commit after the hard expiry is refused SESSION_EXPIRED while the session record still exists (TTL cleanup not run)
No provider call and no external effect for the expired session
The caller is offered re-verification by a person; the outcome is never RESOLVED
